query: INSERT INTO combo_channel_settings (org_id, sell_pos, sell_qr, sell_online, sell_delivery) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET sell_pos = EXCLUDED.sell_pos, sell_qr = EXCLUDED.sell_qr, sell_online = EXCLUDED.sell_online, sell_delivery = EXCLUDED.sell_delivery, updated_at = now()
